title: Load tomorrow's material orders onto trucks
heading: Several Knapsacks Share the Items: One Binary per Item and Knapsack
cases: a loading within every truck's weight and volume is allowed, and one over a truck's volume or over its weight is refused
an order put on two trucks at once is refused
two orders for the same job site on two different trucks are refused, although each of them ships
one order of a job site shipping while another waits is refused, whichever of the two ships
